references.text: Jesus' prayer to the Father confirms that he has not lost any of those given to him, except the one destined for destruction, which directly reflects the promise to keep all who were given to him in John 6:39.
Here Jesus expresses that no one can snatch them out of his hand, and that he gives them eternal life so they will not perish, a direct response to the concern about losing anyone in 6:39.
Martha affirms belief in the resurrection on the last day, which is the specific timeframe Jesus mentions for raising up those given to him in 6:39.
Jesus emphasizes that his words will judge on the last day, linking to the same eschatological event (the last day) where the resurrection occurs in 6:39.
Jesus explains that the Father raises the dead, and that the Son's will is to give life, establishing the theological basis for the Father's will to raise up those given to the Son in 6:39.
